name: Developers who want AI engineering skills
who: Working full-stack / web developers (and serious career changers) who feel left behind by AI and want production AI skills: RAG, agents, evals, context engineering. Busy, skeptical of bootcamps and hype.
pains: My skills are becoming obsolete and I'm getting left behind
I think this needs deep math/ML I don't have
I just use Claude/Cursor and call it progress; I don't understand the system
I built a tutorial chatbot and don't really understand what I built
I've heard of RAG, agents, context engineering but can't explain them
I have a full-time job, I can't take on a second one
claims: Brian built and led production AI systems (RAG pipelines, production agents) at two different companies
Parsity's AI Engineering program teaches evals, context engineering, RAG pipelines and production agent architecture
About 2-4 hours a week, cohort-based, text-first curriculum
Backed by a U.S. Department of Labor grant; Claude-certified partner
Capstone can be built from a real work project
It's adding AI skills on top of full-stack work, not a pivot into ML
never: Never promise jobs, placement, or salaries
cta: Comment "AI" and I'll send you my free 5-day course where you build your first RAG app.

name: Business owners who want to replace software
who: Owners and operators of small/mid businesses (dealerships, trades, clinics, agencies, local service) paying for clunky or overpriced SaaS, legacy industry software, or running on spreadsheets. Not technical. Care about money, time, and missed customers.
pains: Paying per-seat for software we use 10% of
Our industry software is ancient and nobody likes it
We run the business on spreadsheets and sticky notes
Missed calls and slow lead replies are losing us customers
Custom software sounds expensive, slow, and risky
Agencies quote six figures and take months
claims: Brian is a senior software engineer who has built production AI systems at two companies
He co-builds AIVARA, which replaces legacy car-dealership software and answers leads in about 60 seconds
He installs voice AI for businesses where a missed call is lost money
AI tools mean a custom build that once took months can now be scoped and prototyped in days
Send what you use today and get a real estimate within 24 hours, plus a working demo when the project is a fit
never: No made-up savings numbers or client results; use 'for example' math clearly framed as an example
Don't trash specific vendors by name
cta: Comment "REPLACE" with the software you hate paying for, and I'll tell you if we can build you your own version.
